why.en: No new US close or crisis report over the weekend, so this week's confirmed dates (GDP/PCE, Bank of Korea) lead, followed by the new research's S&P 500 drawdown and the freshly changed market-cap ranks. Yesterday's VIX 35.89 and the lock-up countdown (same close) were left out as repeats.

UU. ni informe de crisis durante el fin de semana, primero van las fechas confirmadas de esta semana (PIB/PCE, Banco de Corea), luego la caída del S&P 500 del nuevo informe y el cambio en el ranking.
